questions.question: State Linear regression. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• State Linear Regression. [E] / [CO2]
  • Linear regression is a statistical method used to study the relationship between two variables.
  • It helps predict the value of one variable based on the value of another variable. The
  • relationship is represented by a straight-line equation.

questions.question: Define Statistics. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Define Statistics. [U] / [CO1]
  • Statistics is the science of collecting, organizing, presenting, analyzing, and interpreting
  • numerical data. It helps in decision -making and drawing meaningful conclusions from data.
  • Statistics is widely used in business, economics, and research.

questions.question: State the situation of ill-defined mode. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• State the situation of ill-defined mode. [U] / [CO3]
  • Mode becomes ill-defined when no value repeats frequently in a dataset or when two or more
  • values occur with the same highest frequency. In such situations, it is difficult to identify a
  • unique mode. The distribution may then be called bimodal or multimodal.

  • Geometric Mean.

questions.question: State the merits and demerits of Range / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• State the merits and demerits of Range. [U] / [CO4]
  • Range is the simplest measure of dispersion and is calculated as the difference between the
  • highest and lowest values in a dataset. One major merit of range is that it is easy to calculate
  • and understand. It helps in obtaining a quick idea about the variability of data. However, range
  • is affected only by extreme values and ignores all other observations in the series. Therefore,
  • it is considered less reliable for detailed statistical analysis.

questions.question: How can statistics be misused intentionally? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• How can statistics be misused intentionally? [U] / [CO1]
  • Statistics can be misused intentionally by presenting incomplete or misleading data to support
  • false conclusions. People may manipulate graphs, averages, or percentages to create a wrong
  • impression among viewers. Biased sampling and selective use of data are also co mmon
  • methods of statistical misuse. Such misuse can influence public opinion, business decisions,
  • and policy making unfairly. Therefore, statistics should be used honestly and interpreted
  • carefully.

questions.question: Define regression. State the important features / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Define regression. State the important features. [E] / [CO2]
  • Regression is a statistical technique used to study the relationship between two or more
  • variables and to predict the value of one variable based on another. It helps in measuring the
  • effect of an independent variable on a dependent variable. Regression an alysis is widely used
  • in business, economics, and research for forecasting and decision -making. One important
  • feature of regression is that it establishes a functional relationship between variables through
  • regression equations. Another feature is that it helps in prediction and estimation, and
  • regression coefficients indicate the direction and degree of relationship between variables.
